tasks.note: The 'generate images or video' quote is a fragment of a homepage sentence about ad creatives.

can_execute.quote: You choose how AI Marketer operates: autonomous execution or a human-approved workflow.
can_execute.note: FAQ answer, confirmed on a second read. Body text on the same page: 'Audit your Facebook and Instagram campaigns, find optimization opportunities, and act on them' (with autonomous execution or approval).

multi_agent.note: The AI Marketer page describes one agent and says 'Custom Agents are a separate workflow with their own capabilities and release schedule.' A link label 'Facebook Ads Orchestrator' exists with no description. Nothing says agents work together.

integrations.note: From the pricing-page FAQ about the One-Click Report: 'Meta Ads, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Shopify, Klaviyo, and TikTok.' There is no integrations page.

pricing.note: Weak value. The pricing page hides the main plan price ('See price inside the app.', with a '$ 0 … /mo' placeholder in the text) and shows only an add-on, Tracking Pro, at '$49/mo'. The homepage shows '$29/mo' as an 'Early-Bird Offer'. free_tier is true because of a trial: 'Try 100% free for 7 days. Cancel Anytime'.

hq_location.note: No address, city or legal entity on the homepage, about, contact or pricing pages; the footer reads '© 2025 All rights reserved madgicx.com'.

notes: The main plan price is not in the page text (a placeholder '$ 0' is), so it is probably filled in by JavaScript; a plain fetcher will not see a real plan price.
